title: 85 South: Ghetto Legends
overview: DC Young Fly, Karlous Miller and Chico Bean bring their famous podcast to the stage to create a unique comedy special where nothing and no one is safe from their jokes.

title: Arsenio Hall: Smart and Classy
overview: In his first stand-up special, Arsenio Hall discusses getting older, the changing times and culture, social issues and even bothersome baby toes.

title: Chappelle's Home Team - Earthquake: Legendary
overview: Earthquake shakes up the stage with his takes on "health is wealth," prostate exams and one particularly lengthy celebrity funeral.

title: D.L. Hughley: Contrarian
overview: Comedian D.L. Hughley riffs on politics, "Black Panther," his upbringing and more in a rapid-fire stand-up show at Philadelphia's Merriam Theater.

title: Deon Cole: Ok, Mister
overview: From the telltale signs of aging to bedroom mishaps and dating deal-breakers, Deon Cole spins comedy gold in this playfully candid special.

title: DeRay Davis: How to Act Black
overview: Dynamic comic DeRay Davis hits the stage like a ball of fire, nailing the finer points of living, dating and handling show business as a black man.

title: Eric Andre: Legalize Everything
overview: Comedian Eric Andre presents his very first Netflix original stand-up special. Taking the stage in New Orleans, Andre breaks the boundaries of comedy as he critiques the war on drugs, the war on sex, and the war on fart jokes!

title: Fadily Camara: La plus drôle de tes copines
overview: Irrepressible French comedian Fadily Camara weaves jokes, vivid characters and physical comedy into a lively stand-up show at La Cigale in Paris.

title: Hannibal Buress: Comedy Camisado
overview: He's a kamikaze gambler. A one-arm cuddler. And if his fly is down, so be it. A night of sly riffs and slow burns.

title: Kevin Hart: Zero F**ks Given
overview: Kevin Hart serves up laughs and brick oven pizza from the comfort of his home, and dishes on male group chats, sex after 40 and life with COVID-19.

title: Leslie Jones: Time Machine
overview: From trying to seduce Prince to battling sleep apnea, Leslie Jones traces her evolution as an adult in a joyfully raw and outrageous stand-up special.

title: London Hughes: To Catch A D*ck
overview: London Hughes, the sauciest comedian to come out of the UK, takes us on a brilliant and bold tour of her d*ck catching history.

title: Lucas Brothers: On Drugs
overview: Deadpan twin comics Keith and Kenny Lucas take the stage in Brooklyn with a set that touches on drugs, race, Deion Sanders, teachers and O.J. Simpson.

title: Marlon Wayans: Woke-ish
overview: An American stand-up comedy special starring Marlon Wayans who jokes about racism, hip-hop, gay rights, and raising kids.

title: Michael Che Matters
overview: "SNL" star Michael Che takes on hot-button topics like inequality, homophobia and gentrification in this stand-up set filmed live in Brooklyn.

title: Michelle Buteau: A Buteau-ful Mind at Radio City Music Hall
overview: Michelle Buteau talks going viral, raising twins, and the lows of getting high in this herstory-making special.

title: Michelle Buteau: Welcome to Buteaupia
overview: Scene-stealing queen Michelle Buteau dazzles with real talk on relationships, parenthood, cultural differences and the government workers who adore her.

title: Mike Epps: Indiana Mike
overview: Filmed at the Walker Theatre in his hometown of Indianapolis, with an audience that includes the Mayor, the Indiana Pacers, and his criminal lawyer since 1992, Mike Epps returns for his third hour-long Netflix comedy special. Epps exclaims what he loves about Indiana, his parents’ legacy and much more.

title: Mike Epps: Only One Mike
overview: In a raw stand-up comedy special, Mike Epps mixes it up as he tackles sexual misconduct, special ed, aging body parts and much more.

title: Mo Gilligan: Momentum
overview: Comedian Mo Gilligan blends smooth moves and sharp humor as he riffs on humble beginnings, family dynamics and the complex art of dancing in the club.

title: Mo Gilligan: There's Mo to Life
overview: Mo Gilligan breaks down his days as a broke teenager, working in retail, relationship dynamics, annoying talk show producers and more in this special.

title: My Name Is Mo'Nique
overview: You think you know Mo'Nique? From staring down a racist teacher to her grandmother's sex warning, she spills all in this stand-up comedy special.

title: Nicole Byer: BBW (Big Beautiful Weirdo)
overview: Nicole takes the stage at the Gramercy Theatre for a HOT new set, discussing everything from how she basically is a vegan (she's just doing her part), what she's looking for in a man, and just how crazy this past year-and-a-half has been.

title: Reggie Watts: Spatial
overview: The comic innovator delivers a surreal set blending experimental songs, jokes about grits, guns and drugs, and other improvised comedy adventures.

title: Sam Jay: 3 in the Morning
overview: Comedian and "Saturday Night Live" writer Sam Jay serves up fresh takes on relationships, travel nightmares, the audacity of white people and more.

title: Sommore: Queen Chandelier
overview: This Queen of Comedy shines as she takes the stage to sound off on her suspicion of free stuff, social media prayer requests, fake lashes and ugly shoes.

title: Tiffany Haddish Presents: They Ready
overview: Tiffany Haddish introduces her favorite comedians in a series of stand-up performances.

title: Tracy Morgan: Staying Alive
overview: In his first special since his serious car accident, Tracy Morgan cracks jokes about life in a coma, his second marriage and his family's dark side.

title: Trevor Noah: Afraid of the Dark
overview: The 'Daily Show' host ponders the perils of naming countries, how traffic lights turn New Yorkers invincible and why you shouldn't drink in Scotland.

title: Trigger Warning with Killer Mike
overview: In this funny and provocative series, rapper and activists Killer Mike puts his revolutionary ideas about achieving social change into action.

title: W. Kamau Bell: Private School Negro
overview: Comedian W. Kamau Bell muses on parenting in the Trump era, "free speech" dustups, woke children's TV and his fear of going off the grid.

title: Yuri Marçal: Honest Mistake
overview: From sharing his unique views on family, race and religion to detailing an online rift that blew up, Brazilian comedian Yuri Marçal isn't holding back.
